## About
K and D Auto Glass handles replacement and service for all of your auto glass needs from our shop on N. Hamilton Rd in Whitehall. We believe in treating our customers fairly because we want your business now, and far into the future.
Competitive rates and fast service mean you get good value for your time and money. Call us for a quote and we will talk you through it.
We hold a 4.7 rating from 34 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote that Jeff came out to his office and then his home to sort out a windshield rain sensor problem, and would not take any payment for it.

## Services
- Windshield replacement: Full windshield replacement. One reviewer dropped off their vehicle and got a call a few hours later that it was done.
- Rock chip repair: We repair rock chips.
- Door and back glasses: We replace door glasses and back glasses.
- Side view mirrors: We replace side view mirrors.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: Can you come to me, and can it be done today?
A: Free mobile service and same day service are available. Give us a call to set it up.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are at 171 N. Hamilton Rd, Suite H in Whitehall. One reviewer mentioned the location can be hard to find, so call us if you need directions.
